name: ContextFriend - Quiet Blue
status: Proposed visual specification, not production code or implementation verification

typography.fontFamily: Platform system sans with native Hebrew and German support
typography.notes: Respect platform text scaling. Do not shrink essential text or fix height to fit translations. Consent and privacy disclosures use readable body or supporting text.

dimensionsDp.notes: Minimums are not fixed heights. System bars, display cutouts, IME and native navigation remain inside safe layout constraints.

motion.notes: No perpetual decorative animation. Live waveform only from real microphone signal. Progress indicators only reflect real work.

semanticRules: Use semantic tokens, not per-component lavender defaults.
Use navy text on yellow, never small white text on yellow.
Pair status color with a readable status label.
Only show a local provenance badge for a result known to have been produced locally.
Storage location is separate from processing location.
No speech is an empty/error outcome, not a reviewable summary.
Review applies to a content version and resets after substantive edits or regeneration.
Recording is an action, not a bottom-navigation destination.
Keep the paired-eye motif small and restrained. It is a proposed concept mark, not an approved brand replacement.
Use logical start/end layout and isolate technical LTR values inside RTL text.
Keep the hero compact after initial use so real meetings remain visible.

validation.notes: Proposed acceptance targets. Native device and TalkBack verification still required; browser mock validation cannot certify native behavior.
